verdict.rationale: Logseq presents itself as a privacy-first, open-source knowledge base, and community users confirm it runs on local data, is offline-first, and has no mandatory subscription. Logseq Sync is an optional vendor service, so the local-only branch of the story is met; GitHub-based syncing is a user workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of local-only/offline operation, any self-hosted sync backend option.
